data.desc: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. (NASDAQ: SCNI) operates a contract development and manufacturing business alongside an immunology-focused therapeutic development platform. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd., serves biotechnology and pharmaceutical customers through facilities in Jerusalem and Yavne, Israel. The Company develops its NanoAb platform through research collaboration and license arrangements with the Max Planck Society and University Medical Center Göttingen in Germany.
